description: React component for dashboard tab management, including tab rendering, drag-and-drop reordering, deletion, and active tab handling within a dashboard UI.

methods.name: CloseIconWithDropIndicator
methods.description: React component rendering a close icon with optional drop indicator for tab deletion.

methods.name: handleClickTab
methods.description: Handles tab selection, updates active tab state, and logs the event.

methods.name: handleDropOnTab
methods.description: Handles drop events on tabs, activating the dropped tab.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles general drop events, delegating if not a tab type.

methods.name: handleDeleteTab
methods.description: Deletes a tab and activates the previous tab if needed.

methods.name: showDeleteConfirmModal
methods.description: Shows confirmation modal for tab deletion.

methods.name: handleGetDropPosition
methods.description: Determines drop position indicators during drag-and-drop.

methods.name: handleTabsReorder
methods.description: Reorders tabs and updates active tab index.
